games.title: Sludge
games.description:
Survival island and cave exploration game with resource gathering, crafting, grid base building, and night raids.
New Update v1.2:
Added:
- Craftable chests (6x4 storage)
- Rivers and fishing (catch fish and rare loot)
- Sandbox mode (unlocks after surviving 5 nights; includes fly, god mode, entity spawner, and custom stats)
- Item drops upon death
- Dynamic difficulty ranks (Brutal, Hardcore, Ultrahardcore, True Hardcore) with custom HP bar patterns
- World details view (playtime, active challenges, and copyable seed)
- Expanded settings menu (volume, sensitivity, brightness, and more)
- Game version display in the bottom-right corner

Changed:
- More varied and random world generation
- Upgraded sound effects for a more realistic feel
- Free-form building anywhere, as long as it is connected to a foundation
- You can now destroy your own buildings
- Mouse wheel hotbar slot switching
- Reduced frequency of on-screen pop-up messages (like headshot alerts) to keep the screen clear

Removed:
- "Respawn on Island" button (prevented cheating and unintended world resets)

Fixed:
- Various collision issues
